entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned A.P.P. for the State.
2. The petitioner apprehends his arrest in a case registered for the offences punishable under Sections 419, 420, 465, 466, 467, 468, 471 and 120(B) of the Indian Penal Code.

3. Call for a legible carbon/photostat copy of the case diary relating to Marhowrah P.S. Case No. 526 of 2024 i.e. the instant case and Marhowrah P.S. Case No. 53 of 2024 from the Court of the learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Saran at Chapra/Successor Court, for the reason that the informant alleges that petitioner had instituted Marhowrah P.S. Case No. 53 of 2024 and the informant of the present case was the Investigating Officer of Marhowrah P.S. Case No. 53 of 2024.

During the course of investigation, it transpired based on the report of the Medical Board that injury report of Marhowrah Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.3038 of 2025(3) dt.08-05-2025 P.S. Case No. 53 of 2024 was fake, thus, the instant FIR was instituted against the petitioner, who was informant of Marhowrah P.S. Case No. 53 of 2024, alleging that the petitioner with the help of the Doctor manipulated the fake injury report for implicating Vivek Kumar Singh who was made an accused in Marhowrah P.S. Case No. 53 of 2024.
4. Learned counsel for the petitioner further submits that the informant of the instant FIR without holding a proper investigation instituted the FIR implicating the petitioner as an accused.

sentences.text: There shall be no coercive action against the petitioner, in connection with Marhowrah P.S. Case No. 526 of 2024, until the anticipatory bail application is finally adjudicated by this Court.

6. Put up this case on 30.06.2025.
(Satyavrat Verma, J) Kundan/-
